subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses present, past and future tenses; builds word bank; uses a dictionary

show.line: Yesterday I played. Today I play. Tomorrow I will play. Will tells us it has not happened yet!

rounds.prompt: Tomorrow we, gap, to the beach. Which words fit?
rounds.praise: Will go! Tomorrow has not happened yet.

rounds.prompt: Yesterday Gogo, gap, bread. Which word fits?
Today I read. Tomorrow I, what? Say the words.

rounds.praise: Yes! I will swim. Not yet, but soon.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence is about right now?
Yesterday, today or tomorrow? Put each sentence in its group.

hints: Tomorrow? Use will. I will play.
Yesterday? The word changes. Play, played.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Tomorrow I, gap, my gogo.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Tomorrow has not happened yet. Tomorrow I will visit my gogo.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Tomorrow I will visit my gogo!

parent_line: Can talk about yesterday, today and tomorrow with the right words, including will.
